layers.authority: Município de Bonito (Secretaria de Turismo), described by the Mato Grosso do Sul state government
layers.process: In Bonito the natural attractions (river snorkelling, caves, rafting and similar) are visited through the single voucher system (Voucher Único), in use since 1995. A voucher is bought from a local travel agency, prices are set in a published table that changes with season, and each attraction has a daily limit on visitors, so places are booked ahead. The state news agency says the voucher is issued only by tourism agencies and that any outing needs one. The legal act behind it is a municipal matter and was not found, so this is recorded as the municipality's system, not a state law.
